name: Peanut Butter
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as it's FODMAP-free. Choose natural versions without added sugars or high-fructose corn syrup.
preparationTips: Choose natural peanut butter with only peanuts and salt listed
Avoid varieties with added honey, agave, or high-fructose corn syrup
Store natural peanut butter upside down to make mixing easier
Warm slightly if too thick for spreading
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of niacin and magnesium
